definitions.explanation: In all of recorded history. Used as a modifier before superlatives to emphasize something as the most extreme or notable in history.

examples.japanese: {史上|しじょう}{最高|さいこう}の{記録|きろく}だ。
examples.english: It is the highest record in history.

examples.japanese: {史上|しじょう}{初|はじ}めての{快挙|かいきょ}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
{今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}は{観測|かんそく}{史上|しじょう}{最|もっと}も{暑|あつ}い{夏|なつ}だったと{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: It was announced that this summer was the hottest on record.

notes:
Almost always appears before superlatives like {最高|さいこう} (highest), {最悪|さいあく} (worst), {最大|さいだい} (biggest), or {初|はじ}めて (first time). Very common in news headlines and sports commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {史上|しじょう}{最高|さいこう}: the highest in history
- {史上|しじょう}{最悪|さいあく}: the worst in history
- {史上|しじょう}{初|はじ}めて: for the first time in history
- {史上|しじょう}{最年少|さいねんしょう}: the youngest in history
